title: First Integrated National Outcomes and Dependency Graph
scope: Four initial manuscript domains and eight shared capabilities. Typed research relationships, safeguard conditions and legal authority review gates only; no implementation mandates.

semantic_contract.supports: Proposed contribution to a people-centered outcome, not a validated causal estimate.
semantic_contract.depends_on: Potential enabling condition, not proof that no alternative path exists.
semantic_contract.conflicts_with: Conditional risk from a specified option or pathway; never an assertion that two public values cannot coexist.
semantic_contract.constrained_by: Limits the design space. A normative constraint is not automatically existing enforceable law.
semantic_contract.requires_legal_authority: A pending jurisdiction- and action-specific legal research gate, not an authorization or conclusion that a proposed act is lawful.
